name: Greetings
about: Say hello and goodbye and introduce yourself.

name: Numbers and time
about: Count, say the time and use days and months.

name: Pronunciation
about: Soft d, silent letters, vowels and the stød.

name: En and et
about: Know if a noun is an en-word or an et-word.

name: Present tense
about: Use verbs in the present tense with -r.

name: Pronouns
about: Use jeg and mig, han and ham and the other pairs.

name: Definite form
about: Say the car (bilen) and the house (huset).

name: Plural
about: Make the plural with -er, -e or no ending.

name: Modal verbs
about: Use kan, vil, skal and må with the infinitive.

name: Questions
about: Ask yes/no questions and questions with hv-words.

name: Word order
about: Keep the verb in second place.

name: Negation
about: Put ikke in the right place.

name: Past tense
about: Talk about yesterday with regular and irregular verbs.

name: Perfect tense
about: Use har and er with the participle.

name: Possessives
about: Use min, mit, mine and sin, sit, sine.

name: Comparing
about: Say bigger, biggest, better and best.
